Uptown Wellness Chicago Monthly Pop-Up

Wellness • Community • Connection

Saturday, October 24, 2026 | 1:00 PM–5:00 PM

Yoga Body Elements Frequency Wellness Center

4007 N. Broadway, Chicago, IL

Discover your next favorite wellness experience at the Uptown Wellness Chicago Monthly Pop-Up!** Join us for an afternoon celebrating health, local entrepreneurs, inspiring conversations, and community connection in the heart of Chicago’s Uptown neighborhood.

Hosted at Yoga Body Elements Frequency Wellness Center, this monthly gathering brings together wellness practitioners, conscious businesses, and community members for an afternoon of exploration, education, and inspiration.

✨ What to Expect

Local Vendors:** Shop wellness products, handcrafted goods, and unique offerings from local entrepreneurs.

Guest Speakers:** Hear from inspiring voices sharing insights on holistic wellness, self-care, and conscious living.

Wellness Practitioners:** Meet local professionals and discover holistic services and wellness modalities.

Community Connection:** Connect with like-minded people, support small businesses, and expand your wellness community.

Special Experiences:** Discover unique offerings, demonstrations, and opportunities to explore new wellness practices.

🌿 **Calling All Vendors & Guest Speakers!**

Are you a wellness practitioner, health professional, artist, or creative entrepreneur? We invite you to be part of our growing Uptown Wellness Chicago community!

Share your products, services, knowledge, and passion with an engaged audience interested in wellness, personal growth, and community connection.

Email Y2luZHkgfCBjaW5kaHVzdG9uICEgY29t to get involved!

Come discover. Connect with community. Support local wellness.**

📅 **Date:** Saturday, October 24, 2026

⏰ **Time:** 1:00 PM–5:00 PM

📍 **Location:** Yoga Body Elements Frequency Wellness Center

4007 N. Broadway, Chicago, IL
